feature_policy: only origin-and-earlier sales lags/rolling summaries; future target weekday is deterministic calendar, no external news or future realized values
candidate: pooled scale-normalized direct ridge, 7 separate linear horizons, nonnegative point output
normalization: per-SKU training-only mean bounded below 1; no test preprocessing
model_selection_policy: alpha and winner selected on validation WAPE only; candidate retained for recommended use only if paired test uncertainty against validation-best baseline supports improvement; otherwise retain validation-best baseline
